verse.verse_1: What do they question each other about!
verse.verse_6: Have We not made the earth as a cradle
verse.verse_8: And We created you in pairs,
verse.verse_9: and We made your sleep a rest,
verse.verse_10: and We made the night a mantle,
verse.verse_11: and We made the day for a livelihood.
verse.verse_12: And We built above you seven strong ones,
verse.verse_13: and placed in them a blazing lamp
verse.verse_14: and have sent down from the clouds, pouring rain
verse.verse_15: that We may bring forth with it grain, plants
verse.verse_17: Indeed, the Day of Decision is an appointed time,
verse.verse_18: the Day that the Horn is blown, and you shall come in crowds
verse.verse_19: and heaven is opened, having gates,
verse.verse_20: and the mountains move, and vaporize.
verse.verse_21: Indeed, Gehenna (Hell) has become an ambush,
verse.verse_23: there, they shall live for ages,
verse.verse_24: tasting neither coolness nor any drink
verse.verse_27: Indeed, they did not hope for a Reckoning,
verse.verse_28: and they absolutely belied Our verses,
verse.verse_29: and everything We have numbered in a Book.
verse.verse_30: 'Taste! We shall not increase you except in punishment'
verse.verse_31: But, for the cautious a place of prosperity,
verse.verse_35: There, they shall neither hear idle talk, nor yet any falsehood,
verse.verse_36: a recompense from your Lord, a gift, a reckoning,
verse.verse_37: the Lord of the heavens and earth, and all that is between them, the Merciful, of whom they are unable to speak.
verse.verse_38: On that Day, when the Spirit (Gabriel) and the angels stand in ranks they shall not speak, except he to whom the Merciful has given permission, and sayswhat is right.
verse.verse_39: That is the Day, the truth, so whosoever wills takes a way to his Lord.
verse.verse_40: Indeed, We have forewarned you of an imminent punishment, the Day when the person will look upon his works and the unbelievers will say: 'Would that I were dust'
